pin_regs.reason: Every data input already feeds dedicated unconditional pin registers (raw_src_v/s_bank/header_pin/payload_pin); every ids/dr_v/dr_s/fault output leaves dedicated registers. Preserve those existing stages with keep_pin_regs/pin_reg_split/io_flop_at_pins; adding generic wrapper registers would duplicate them and silently change the static schedule. Native gate must audit actual boundary placement.

structural_change: s81_a2f_control4_resetlocal: actual control4 TT-109ps reset qualification moved after prefix; binary carry prefix replaced by monotone threshold merge to remove remaining CTS-2.9ps data->overflow path; ID priority mux replaced with onehot OR. Full53/4quarters/3slots unchanged; zero added cycles. Native launch/capture budgets tightened, no firm output hold chain. | r2 (S-VM 2210): r1 routed TT +46.1 / FF -5.95 / DRC 0 (s81_a2f_control4_resetlocal_pilot_2118_r1-split4-COMMIT-014095727): every reg D pin FF >= +8.01; the ONLY hold fails are 5 output ports ids[136,144,553,582,32] (-5.95..-0.27 ps) driven QN->INV->output BUFx2 straight from their dedicated pin registers, because r1 had outhold false (no pin hold pad on outputs) and the post-route ECO cannot add one at the port (least-bad FF -16.92). Fix = the recipe pin hold pad on every output (outhold true, HB1xp67, the weakest HB cell, same as inputs): a fixed boundary delay at every output, zero cycles, same RTL/pins/outline/root.
